tools.name: reload
tools.title: Reload
tools.description: Reload the active language-server configuration and reapply it to currently running LSP sessions.

tools.name: inspect
tools.title: Inspect
tools.description: Inspect the symbol at a file position and return documentation, signature details, and related code locations such as definitions, implementations, and type declarations.

file.description: File path to inspect. Accepts either an absolute path or a path relative to the current workspace.

line.description: 1-based line number for the target symbol or cursor position.

character.description: 1-based character number for the target symbol or cursor position.

tools.name: references
tools.title: References
tools.description: Find semantic references to the symbol at a file position across the workspace.

file.description: File path to inspect. Accepts either an absolute path or a path relative to the current workspace.

line.description: 1-based line number for the target symbol or cursor position.

character.description: 1-based character number for the target symbol or cursor position.

tools.name: call_hierarchy
tools.title: Call Hierarchy
tools.description: Inspect incoming and outgoing call relationships for the callable symbol at a file position.

file.description: File path to inspect. Accepts either an absolute path or a path relative to the current workspace.

line.description: 1-based line number for the target symbol or cursor position.

character.description: 1-based character number for the target symbol or cursor position.

direction.description: Which call relationships to include. Defaults to both.

tools.name: completion
tools.title: Completion
tools.description: Get context-aware code completions at a precise file position. For the best results, place the cursor immediately after the trigger point, for example right after `client.`.

file.description: File path to inspect. Accepts either an absolute path or a path relative to the current workspace.

line.description: 1-based line number for the target symbol or cursor position.

character.description: 1-based character number for the target symbol or cursor position.

tools.name: rename
tools.title: Rename
tools.description: Rename the symbol at a file position across the workspace using language-server rename support.

file.description: File path to inspect. Accepts either an absolute path or a path relative to the current workspace.

line.description: 1-based line number for the target symbol or cursor position.

character.description: 1-based character number for the target symbol or cursor position.

newName.description: Replacement name to use for the symbol at the given position.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Search workspace symbols by name or pattern. Result quality depends on the language server and current indexing state.

query.description: Workspace symbol query. Prefer a symbol name, prefix, or API term rather than full-text code.

tools.name: outline
tools.title: Outline
tools.description: Return a hierarchical outline of symbols in a file, including names, kinds, and locations. Use `preview: true` to include short declaration snippets.

file.description: File path to inspect. Accepts either an absolute path or a path relative to the current workspace.

preview.description: Include short declaration previews for symbols. Defaults to false for more compact output.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.title: Diagnostics
tools.description: Return active diagnostics for a file, including errors, warnings, info, and hints reported by the language server.

file.description: File path to inspect. Accepts either an absolute path or a path relative to the current workspace.
